Name: Throb-Terraria Weapons
Author: MrThrob
Description:
[size=4][b]描述[/b][/size]
制作了一些泰拉瑞亚武器，并让他们有了专属的技能

1.吸血鬼匕首:正如泰拉瑞亚游戏中那样，它能散射出能治愈你的匕首
2.泰拉雨伞:伤害比较低，但是它的防御能力极高，有着超强击退，技能可以让你无敌一段时间
3.死神镰刀:高额伤害，技能释放一段旋风斩
4.暗影焰刃:技能释放一段冲刺并在终点处释放闪电造成高额伤害
需要在科罗布斯处购买
Made some Teraria weapons and gave them exclusive skills

1. Vampire Dagger: Just like in the Teraria game, it can scatter a dagger that can heal you
2. Terraria Umbrella: The damage is relatively low, but it has extremely high defense and super repelling. The skills can make you invincible for a period of time
3. Death's Sickle: High damage, skill releases a Cyclone Slash
4. Shadow Flame Blade: Ability releases a sprint and releases lightning at the finish line to deal high damage
Need to be purchased at Korobus

[size=4][b]安装说明[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]将此内容包及所需前置下载，放在mods文件夹即可[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Download this content pack and the required prerequisites and place them in the mods folder[/color]
